g.text: • Goal: Block malicious inbound HTTP/HTTPS traffic before it reaches the internal network.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Tools: Cloudflare WAF, CDN, Rate Limiting, Bot Protection.

g.text: • Goal: Enforce strict network segmentation between DMZ,management, and internal subnets.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Tools: OPNSense Firewall, VLANs, IDS/IPS (Suricata), Firewall Rules.

g.text: • Goal: Secure all administrative access via a centralized, hardened gateway.

g.text: • Tools: SSH Bastion, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Fail2Ban, Key-based Auth.
